name: Lead Scoring to Airtable and Slack
summary: Scores each new sales lead, saves it to Airtable, and tells your team in Slack about the most promising ones.
description: Webhook-triggered: a lead POSTed as JSON (name, email, company, title, employees) to /webhook/leads with the X-Webhook-Secret header gets a 0-100 score from simple rules (company email, company name, senior title, team size — edit them in the Score Lead code node). Every lead is saved to an Airtable table with its score and tier; hot leads (60+) are also posted to Slack. Set the auth token, Airtable credential, base_id and table, and the Slack credential and channel before activating.
